name: dotclaude
description: A workspace pane for Claude Code: vitals rail, edit gate (blocks Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and MultiEdit until you approve; not Bash or MCP tools), plan review, ledger, companion, Mac monitor, notes vault, radar, Git and crew.

vaultPath.title: Notes vault
vaultPath.description: Folder of your Markdown notes (Obsidian vault). ~ is your home folder; absolute paths work too.

vaultName.title: Vault name
vaultName.description: The vault's name in Obsidian, used for obsidian:// links.

conventionsSkill.title: Conventions skill
conventionsSkill.description: Name of a skill under <claude dir>/skills/ whose SKILL.md holds your vault's note conventions; the scribe follows it when present, else built-in conventions.

approvalWords.title: Approval words
approvalWords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases that unlock edits when your message starts with one of them (or is exactly one). Case-insensitive, except a word written in capitals (GO) matches only in capitals.
approvalWords.default: approved, go ahead, proceed, lgtm, ship it, let's do it, sounds good, GO

lockPhrases.title: Lock phrases
lockPhrases.description: Comma-separated words or phrases that lock edits again. Locking wins when a prompt holds both.

companionPort.title: Companion port
companionPort.description: Port of the companion's local server on 127.0.0.1.
